observations: Original loading-to-dispense rejects dispense HasMaterial; only Online checks loading NoMaterial. It sets Transfering before validating belt setting and runs two actual child Tasks/WaitAll, then loading and dispense async motions.

Loading setting uses original name/repository cast getter; original axis/material/SMEMA getters resolve hardware by exact names. Stop also uses loading SMEMA output, so source Stop/output failures must remain distinct from transfer return errors.

The loading material sensor can create TransportUnit(string reason) and Save before dispense transfer. The string constructor creates BaseInfo, Init and timestamp name; the original parameterless constructor is empty, now compiled without preparation initialization in this composition.

Original Init includes opposite-sex/config/coordinate/substrate initialization, TuService modification and both action injections. Original Refresh reinitializes coordinates/substrates, clears vision/height and resets two offsets. The original constructor/Init/Refresh bodies are compiled; coordinate/child-entity/ModifyMatter/row-column/action services remain explicit fixtures.
Manual missing loading material returns None; nonmanual Retry/Cancel/Abort may reset loading state, with Cancel disabling ContinuousFeeding and returning NoStart.

First dispense jam Ignore returns Success outside the successful-material branch without transferring Unit; tail jam Ignore still runs Stop/Clamp(true)/Unit assignment/Refresh and material commit. Preserve this difference.

Controller catch returns Exception without rollback; actual loading parent result switch ignores Exception, only Success publishes current completion and clears PrepareFeeding. Existing-material startup branches separately publish. If system1 is disabled, the parent can set AllowDispenseTransferToBondSignal after non-Success returns as well.
